messages.subject: [R GSoC] Introduction to community!
messages.body_plain:
Hello everyone,
         I am Nilotpal Mrinal, Undergraduate Sophomore majoring in Computer Science. I am willing to participate in GSoC-2020. I am proficient in R and R-Studio. I would love to contribute to the project "Asymptotic Complexity Testing". Can anyone guide me regarding the status of this project?

Regards

Mrinal

messages.subject: R in GSOC 2020
messages.body_plain:
Hi all, I am preparing an application for R project in GSOC'20.

I have also started a wiki here https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2020/wiki/table%20of%20proposed%20coding%20projects -- MENTORS, please add project ideas as soon as possible!

According to the official timeline https://developers.google.com/open-source/gsoc/timeline student applications open March 16.

Thanks
Toby
